collections.name: articles
collections.rules: Anyone can read articles. Only authenticated users can create, update, or delete articles.

collections.name: team
collections.description: Stores editorial and reporter team members
collections.rules: Anyone can read team members. Only authenticated users can manage team members.

collections.name: subscribers
collections.description: Stores Firebase Cloud Messaging push notification subscribers for breaking news
collections.rules: Anyone can subscribe or unsubscribe their device token. Only authenticated users can list all subscribers.

collections.name: breaking_alerts
collections.description: Stores dispatched breaking news push notifications for live client synchronization
collections.rules: Anyone can read recent breaking news alerts. Only authenticated users can send alerts.
